name: Wild Script: Nature
detailed_description:
You've woken up in a primordial forest.

Wild nature surrounds you. Danger waits around every corner. Are you a lone survivor, or will you find allies? Your life hangs in the balance, and your choices are the only thing separating survival from death.

The world is descending into madness.

Twisted by unknown forces, nature has gone wild and the land is rife with strange anomalies. Starving predators hunt you relentlessly! But you're not the only one who's lost and afraid. It is your choice whether others become your friends or your next foes. Tame beasts, offer gifts, trade, and talk, or wage war on all you meet. Your actions will define your karma!

Fight, Explore, Create!

Search the world for priceless, gene-altering artifacts. How far will you push your transformation before you're no longer human? Gather resources, build your defenses, and craft the tools you need to survive. A multi-faceted strategy is your only hope to endure and solve the mystery of this world. The wilds are brutal and unforgiving, so tread carefully. You have only one life. Face the consequences of your actions and learn from defeat. This is a hardcore reality with no second chances!

Are you up to the test?

Developer words:

The world of «Wild Script: Nature» is just a seedling, waiting for your touch to flourish. This isn't just a game, it's a shared canvas, a journey we embark on together.

As a solo developer, my passion fuels this project, but I know the true magic lies in community. Every voice matters. What monsters do you imagine lurking in the shadows? What secrets should be unearthed? Share your ideas, your hopes, your fears with me at support email.

Let's build something extraordinary, step by step. Join the adventure, and let's craft a game that's truly ours.

Because in the end, we're all just players in the same game, united by the power of imagination.

Friendly community is main goal!

Game Features:

  • Procedural generation of the world, enemies, and events, making every adventure unique!

  • A pure physics-based combat system!

  • Fun procedural animations and a signature low-poly art style that sparks your imagination.

  • A mysterious wilderness filled with anomalies, secrets, and random events.

  • Tame any animal!

  • A vast arsenal of weapons, armor, and—most importantly—mystical artifacts!

  • Character progression and skill systems for every character.

  • Base building, customization, and management.

  • A player karma system that reflects your choices.

  • Original text-based quests featuring meaningful choices and party skill checks.

  • Discover the world's lore by finding and deciphering ancient tablets.
